answer: Each new agent must post a refundable identity bond before it can transact. When attacker violet spins up a thousand clones, every clone needs its own locked stake, so forging scale costs linearly instead of copying one free identity. Honest agents like delta and raven redeem their bond after a clean tenure, while agents caught double-signing forfeit theirs to the pool. The price of controlling a voting majority therefore rises with total bonded capital, making a convincing fake swarm economically irrational.
